name: Safe deploy
description: Asks you first, then pulls, builds and restarts one server at a time. Checks the site, and rolls back if anything fails.

nodes.title: Deploy {{input.branch}} to your web servers?
nodes.message: One server at a time: git pull, build, restart.

nodes.title: Deployed {{input.branch}}
nodes.body: Every server is on {{input.branch}} and the health check answered {{nodes.health.status}}.

nodes.command:
set -e
cd /srv/app
git checkout -q ORIG_HEAD
./build.sh
sudo -n systemctl restart app

nodes.title: Deploy failed and was rolled back
